dedupe_keys.name: register of electricity production and storage installations connected to the french grid as re published on local open data portals

description: Register of electricity production and storage installations connected to the French grid, as re-published on local open data portals is a dataset listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by 13 French local portals re-publishing a national dataset. 30 datasets on 13 portals hold the national register of electricity production and storage installations connected to the French transmission and distribution grids (site, technology, installed power, connection level), as re-published or filtered to a local area. Coverage: France; each copy is limited to the area of its portal (for example Bondoufle, Cesson, Corsica, Dunkirk urban community). The copies sit on: ccrm41-centrevaldeloire.opendatasoft.com, data.dunkerque-agglo.fr, data.grandparissud.fr, data.mairie-ris-orangis.fr, data.moissy-cramayel.fr, data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr, data.ville-bondoufle.fr, data.ville-cesson.fr and others. Each copy has its own page, description and export. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/), Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
